html:
A Christian church founded in the Philippines by Felix Manalo, registered in Manila in 1914. It is now one of the largest churches born in the Philippines, with congregations around the world.

Manalo was raised Catholic and passed through several Protestant churches that came with American rule after 1898. He began preaching his own message in 1913. The church teaches that it is the one true church, restored in the Philippines in the last days, with Manalo as God's last messenger. It rejects the Trinity and holds that Jesus is not God. Members follow strict rules and attend worship twice a week.

After Manalo's death in 1963, his son Eraño and then his grandson Eduardo led the church, so it has stayed in one family. It is known for its large, spired chapels and for its members voting as a bloc, which makes politicians court it. In 2014 it opened the Philippine Arena, one of the world's largest indoor arenas. It grew in a land shaped by the Catholic Church since Spanish times. See Philippines.
sum: A Christian church founded in the Philippines by Felix Manalo, registered in Manila in 1914. It is now one of the largest churches born in the Philippines, with congregations around the world.
